title: The Equations of Motion
summary: v = u + at, s = ut + ½at² and v² = u² + 2as: solving real problems about braking, falling and throwing.

ib.note: Equations of uniformly accelerated motion are MYP 4–5 Physics

cbse.chapter: Exploration (2026) Ch 4: Describing Motion Around Us

objectives: I can choose and use the three equations of motion.
I can solve problems about falling objects using g.
I can explain stopping distances using the equations.
misconceptions: The equations work even when acceleration changes.
Heavier objects fall faster (ignoring air resistance).
